title: DUET: Dual-Sparse Inference for Block Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.09239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel token generation through iterative denoising, yet their inference remains costly due to repeated attention over a growing historical prefix and repeated processing of the entire current generation block. Historical attention becomes increasingly expensive as generation progresses, while all current-block positions are propagated through the Transformer at every denoising step even though only a small fraction are typically resolved at that step. In this paper, we introduce Duet, a training-free dual-sparse inference framework that addresses these challenges through prefix Key-Value (KV) sparsity and early query sparsity, respectively. Specifically, Duet exploits the concentration and cross-step stability of historical attention within each generation block to construct a compact historical KV subset that is reused across denoising steps. translated_title: DUET：面向块扩散语言模型的双稀疏推理方法
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLM）通过迭代去噪实现并行的 token 生成，但其推理成本仍然高昂，原因在于需要对不断增长的历史前缀进行反复的注意力计算，并且需要反复处理整个当前生成块。随着生成过程的推进，历史注意力计算的开销越来越大；同时，尽管在每一步去噪中通常只有一小部分位置被解析确定，所有当前块的位置却都要在每一个去噪步骤中完整地通过 Transformer 传播。在本文中，我们提出了 DUET，一个无需训练的双稀疏推理框架，分别通过前缀 Key-Value（KV）稀疏性和早期查询稀疏性来应对上述两个挑战。具体而言，DUET 利用每个生成块内历史注意力的集中性及其跨步骤的稳定性，构建一个紧凑的历史 KV 子集，并在各去噪步骤间复用该子集。在查询稀疏性方面，DUET 通过预测更新位置……
tldr: DUET 是一个无需训练的双稀疏推理框架，通过前缀 KV 稀疏性和早期查询稀疏性，显著降低块扩散语言模型的推理开销。
en_tdlr: DUET is a training-free dual-sparse inference framework that accelerates block diffusion language models by exploiting prefix KV sparsity and early query sparsity.
